english.title: Keeper of un-microchipped cat transfer cat to new keeper - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the keeper of a cat, namely **(..SPECIFY CAT..) which had not been microchipped and was not the subject of a certificate issued under regulation 4 of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023 stating that it should not be microchipped for reasons relating to the health of the animal, transferred that cat to a new keeper
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(1) and 14(2)(a) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
